purpose: Labeled acceptance corpus for the RFC-0120 C3 detector (the pure function: pack-procedure structure in -> {verdict, evidence} out). The detector MUST score every case in this file correctly before it ships. This is the ground-truth oracle the C3 acceptance test runs against.

provenance.miner_output: 15 mined -> 14 deduped candidates; verdicts: 1 clears-bar, 2 borderline, 11 below-bar
provenance.hand_authored_positives: prd-isc-fanout (RFC-0123) + feature-discovery (RFC-0124) were added as hand-authored fixtures AFTER the miner run; they are NOT in the miner's 14 and carry a different provenance than the 13 miner-scored negatives. Recorded honestly so the detector is not trained against a silently-inconsistent label set.

the_bar: RFC-0117 §2.1 (conjunctive): a recurring task-shape JUSTIFIES a native .claude/workflows/<name>.js ONLY if repeatable AND fan-out-on-conditionals/loops AND long-running, with >=~10 independent units per run OR work that would overflow main context. Below the bar, model-orchestrated delegation (Delegation->TeamCreate, Task/Agent, Ensemble) is cheaper and correct.

headline_lesson.unit_count_is_not_the_discriminator: The literal '>=~10 units' leg INVERTS on the two most important cases. mempalace-bridge-parity-sync has units=12 (over the line) but is SKIP. dos-upgrade-scan has units=9 (under the line) but is EMIT. A detector keyed on unit-count would skip the only workflow we shipped and emit the highest-unit reject. The real discriminators are the QUALITATIVE legs: genuine independence of units, a deterministic merge/reduce core, and long-running/context-overflow.
headline_lesson.positives_qualify_via_different_legs: The 3 emits do NOT clear the bar the same way. dos-upgrade-scan clears via OVERFLOW (564K subagent tokens) with a fixed scatter and no loop. prd-isc-fanout clears via OVERFLOW (200+ ISCs) + a deterministic merge core. feature-discovery is the ONLY positive that exercises the fan-out-on-LOOP leg (completeness-loop-until-dry). The detector cannot pass by checking a single leg.
headline_lesson.borderlines_are_where_review_fatigue_liv: The 2 borderline cases (doctrine-rfc-ratify-panel, design-bundle-fork-pipeline) both resolve to SKIP, but they are the cases where a weak detector emits false positives. Defensible evidence output matters most here.
headline_lesson.atom_episode_triple_counted: The miner produced 3 candidates (atom-primitive-redgreen-batch / -red-green-flip / -red-first-green-flip) from ONE episode (commits 7da020e2 + e08a0035). All SKIP; they are not 3 independent negatives. The 13-negative set is ~11 distinct episodes. Does not affect the gate (all SKIP) but tempers the 'distinct negatives' framing.

detector_acceptance.rule: Detector scores 3/3 emit and 13/13 skip, produces defensible evidence on the 2 borderlines, and does NOT use raw unit-count as the primary signal (or it fails on its own training data).
detector_acceptance.scoring_depth_caveat: RESOLVED 2026-05-29 (P3): all 8 formerly-shallow negatives deep-scored against git artifacts and confirmed SKIP — none is a hidden EMIT, so the gate is not poisoned. The two fan-out-named candidates (mempalace-recall-isc-fanout, atom-primitive-red-first-green-flip) were false flags (ISC-list naming; within-run recurrence). All 16 cases now scoring_depth=deep.
detector_acceptance.feature_discovery_evidence_caveat: feature-discovery is QUARANTINED pending a dry-converged re-attestation (P3). Until then the emit set is 2 confirmed (dos-upgrade-scan, prd-isc-fanout) + 1 provisional (feature-discovery). The acceptance test '3/3 emit' treats feature-discovery as provisional.

leg_schema.repeatable: observed recurrence RUN-OVER-RUN (not units within a single run)
leg_schema.fan_out_conditional_loop: fan-out driven by a conditional/loop over a dynamic-N input set, vs a fixed hardcoded roster
leg_schema.long_running: multi-hour / context-spanning / detached execution with retry-pause-resume value
leg_schema.units_independent: the parallel units are genuinely independent (disjoint inputs, no cross-deps, not single-voice-coupled, not same-family epistemic clones)
leg_schema.ge10_or_overflow: the OR clause: >=~10 independent units per run OR a payload that would overflow main context
leg_schema.deterministic_merge_core: an agent->code->report reduce step exists where merge/score/dedup/tier is pure deterministic code, keeping the heavy payload out of the orchestrator
leg_schema.already_served_elsewhere: an existing skill / sync-check / TeamCreate path already covers this cheaply

cases.name: dos-upgrade-scan
cases.cluster: DOSUpgrade + Algorithm doctrine — reflection mining + amendment ratification
cases.evidence: 7 on-disk runs + explicit 14-day cadence. 9 parallel agents over DISJOINT inputs (TELOS files vs skill dir vs release notes vs reflections jsonl), zero cross-deps. 564,743 subagent tokens / 233s / 109 tool uses — unambiguous context-overflow (the decisive OR-satisfier). Deterministic scoring (priority=(relevance*2)+impact+effort, relevance<3 filter, 4 score-banded tiers) lived as fragile re-derived prose. Today's model-orchestration is the PROBLEM (orchestrator must re-ingest all 9 payloads). Units straddle ~10, so the verdict rests on the overflow branch (conf 0.86, not higher).

cases.name: prd-isc-fanout
cases.evidence: Per-domain ISC decomposition fans one agent per domain (dynamic N). The 200+-ISC payload never re-enters the orchestrator context (overflow). Convergence is a SINGLE ISC-editor agent (the conceptual-integrity make-or-break — an agent, NOT deterministic, because cross-domain vocabulary/granularity drift cannot be normalized mechanically). Final merge-count IS deterministic code: dedup, splitting-test flags, progress denominator, coverage map.

cases.evidence: scout -> per-dimension fan-out -> completeness-critic LOOP-until-2-dry-passes -> single-voice converge. cases.name: doctrine-rfc-ratify-panel
cases.evidence: Fixed 7-seat roster (5 Council + RedTeam + Cato), no dynamic loop. 7 < ~10, a single RFC fits main context (no overflow). DECISIVE structural disqualifier (RFC-0105): 5/7 seats are same-session Claude-family — epistemically ~1 independent unit (only Cato is genuinely out-of-family). Synthesis needs verdicts IN context. The real unmet need is an out-of-session deliberation LOG (audit/provenance artifact), not an orchestration-throughput problem. Borderline because recurrence(6)+units(7) are genuine, but the conjunctive bar fails.

cases.name: design-bundle-fork-pipeline
cases.evidence: Already ships as the /design-bundle Skill (commit b91f1715). recurrence=1 (one fork on disk; siblings are referenced, not produced — speculative recurrence). Phase B is a FIXED 6 Explore lanes (hardcoded RunPipeline.md:163-172), not a dynamic-N loop. Phase D is ~50 SEQUENTIAL cross-dependent file writes (tokens->intelligence->copy->press). Only genuinely-parallel segment is the disqualified fixed-6. Overflow absorbed by the 6 subagents. Moot — correct primitive (skill) already exists.

cases.name: atom-primitive-redgreen-batch
cases.cluster: v0.0.18 sprint — Sentinel R-rules + Bucket A delivery
cases.evidence: 2 commits 12 min apart in one session (not long-running). All 8 atoms landed in ONE red commit + ONE green commit — no per-atom fan-out. Units DELIBERATELY coupled: single-voice conceptual-integrity owner (ISC-6) + shared Tests/atoms/_helpers.ts — independence is what the design FORBIDS. recurrence=8 counts within-run atoms, not run-over-run episodes (there is exactly 1 episode). Textbook KentBeck red-green loop -> solo / TeamCreate.

cases.name: doctrine-council-redteam-cato-review
cases.cluster: v0.0.18 sprint — Sentinel R-rules + Bucket A delivery
cases.evidence: Peak N=6, fixed roster (only branch is optional Round 2 counter-injection). Bounded 3-round in-context deliberation. CRITICAL: synthesis REQUIRES all verdicts to land in the orchestrator's context — so the workflow's headline advantage (results bypass main context) is actively COUNTERPRODUCTIVE. RFC-0117 §2.1 explicitly routes 'bounded fan-out, results needed in-context' to Agent/TeamCreate. This council-redteam-cato motion IS the ratification gate itself. conf 0.95.

cases.name: mempalace-bridge-parity-sync
cases.cluster: MemPalace + infra — pure-uv migration, recall hardening, bridge parity
cases.evidence: ★ KEY INVERSION CASE: units=12 (OVER the ~10 line) yet SKIP. The 12 are heterogeneous judgment-laden edits (KentBeck reword, Pragmatic Tip-100 gloss, Media new Emoji/FaceSwap blocks, 308-line Sentinel rewrite, 1283-line new mempalace-client.ts) — NOT N identical transforms; they collapse into a handful of decision-clusters. The genuinely-mechanical slice (four-copy SKILL propagation) is ALREADY mechanized by sync-check --fix + drift-check. recurrence=1 (commit 0b9ab9e5). overflow=false. This case is the proof that unit-count is NOT the discriminator.
